svg.text: MPx-SQ2-010…014 · Tap, backflush and inspection accessories
MPx Squeeze v2 (Mini) · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. 10: 28 PCO male neck; bore Ø20 × 31 deep so the prefilter cup fits inside it in tap mode.
2. 11 and 12 are the v1 parts unchanged (M24 female taps; plain spouts Ø14–22).
3. 13: PCO side takes a bottle of clean water or item 10; M12×1 side screws onto the stem with the sleeve pulled open.
4. 14: cassette drops into the Ø45.4 pocket; a drop of water or Nile red stain, then the Ø50 cover glass on the 0.3 step.
5. All tap faces sealed with S6; S7 on the face of 13.
